name: Spatial context on previously unused validation regions
hypothesis: Adding local RGB means and standard deviations improves prediction in different vegetation regions.

features.raw_rgb: 111 original RGB values / 255, in channel-major chronological order
features.context_5: raw RGB plus 5x5 local RGB means and population standard deviations; 333 features
features.context_25: raw RGB plus 25x25 local RGB means and population standard deviations; 333 features

neighborhood_policy: Unmasked original photographs; reflect only at photograph boundaries; never use species or ROI membership to alter features.
training: Original 10996 fitting indices, excluding centers within Chebyshev distance 24 of retained validation or any test center; 10113 retained. No extra ROIs used for training.
validation: Ten ROIs absent from original training and test: exclude centers within Chebyshev distance 24 of any test center; 30114 retained. All ten ROIs remain nonempty.
validation_limitation: Classes 2 and 4 have no additional ROI and are not validated. Different ROIs do not establish independent plants, sites or years.

separation.reason: Ensure non-overlapping 25x25 photograph footprints across training, validation and test. Apply the same training membership to every model.

selection: Choose between context_5 and context_25 by averaging validation ROI accuracy within each species, then equally across the four validated species. A tie chooses context_5. Always retain raw_rgb as the matched comparator, even if it outperforms both context variants.
test: Evaluate raw_rgb and the selected context variant once, after saving selection and fitted-model hashes. Retain all 14105 original test pixels; do not refit after selection or test evaluation.
reporting: Report validation results for all three candidates and test accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro F1, confusion matrices, per-species recall, feature extraction time and fit time for the two frozen models.
interpretation: Exploratory follow-up: historical test outcomes were already observed.
Compare spatial features against this experiment's buffered raw model; its training membership differs from the historical 38.91% GLM.
A single deterministic GLM fit per representation; no three-seed uncertainty claim.
Retain results even if context worsens performance; no test-driven changes to this shortlist.
Notebook, original result files, reference materials and submission archive remain unchanged.
